text: One thing. The offline key escrow. It's in a safe in the emergency equipment store, and the safe is the problem.
style: Hospital chief technology officer in her early fifties, British-Korean, privately educated. Speak with a consistent British Received Pronunciation accent throughout — do not shift to any other accent. Controlled mid-range pitch that keeps catching; clipped, careful pace. Authoritative on the surface, guilty and frightened underneath.
